opening.title: My grandmother taught for 50 years.
opening.body: Marathi and mathematics, to generations of children. Tutor Grandma puts a teacher like her beside every child.

opening.title: Ages 5 to 8 learn by listening.
opening.body: It's when a child moves from the home language to English. A phone is the wrong teacher at that age, and good play school is out of reach for most families.

opening.title: Parents can't guide their child's AI.
opening.body: Today it's settings, toggles and presets. A child changes every day. A preset doesn't.

opening.title: AI already teaches IQ. We build EQ.
opening.body: Every lesson becomes a reason for the child to run to Mumma and Papa.

opening.title: Parents guide. They don't control.
opening.body: No settings. Mumma and Papa just talk, in plain words, in a group chat. Nani listens.

anatomy.label: The voice agent
anatomy.card: Nani, the voice agent. A child just talks. She listens, thinks and answers like a grandma, in Hindi and English.

anatomy.label: The screen
anatomy.card: The wall. Words become pictures, spelling boards and cheers, with no phone in the child's hand.

anatomy.label: The heart: AI agents and the parents' group chat
anatomy.card: The guidance system. Mumma and Papa chat with Nani's team: ⏰ Routine, 🏠 House rules, 📚 Lessons, 📔 Memory. Each agent owns one file, and every message can change how Nani teaches, live.

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.note: She greets him by name, says one line about yesterday and starts today's letter, M.

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.expect: Raat ko aasmaan mein aur kaun aata hai?
steps.expectMeaning: Who else comes to the sky at night?

helps.text: Nothing is pre-recorded. Whatever Aarav says becomes the lesson.
helps.hood: Speech-to-text (ElevenLabs Scribe) → Claude Haiku 5.5, thinking off → ElevenLabs v4 Turbo voice. brain.md gives her yesterday.

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.note: Chand ko English mein Moon kehte hain. M for Moon! The Moon card, then the _OON board with three tiles.

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.expect: The tile flies in and the wall cheers.

helps.text: Hindi in, English out. Chand becomes Moon: the bridge from the home language to English, built from his own words.
helps.hood: Today's bridge words go to speech-to-text as keyterms. Markers in Nani's reply drive every card and board.

steps.speaker: Mumma
steps.line: Remind him to drink water now, and then every 2 hours
steps.note: ⏰ Routine replies, the job appears on the jobs board with its countdown, and Nani reminds Aarav at once.

steps.speaker: Mumma
steps.line: When you count, count in Hindi and English both

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.expect: Ek, one! Do, two! Teen, three!

helps.text: No settings page. Mumma just said it, and seconds later Nani changed how she teaches.
helps.hood: A sorter routes each message to one agent. Routine writes heartbeat jobs on the real clock. House rules writes a new version of its file, and every version is kept.

steps.speaker: Papa
steps.line: I'm bringing mangoes for him tonight
steps.note: 📚 Lessons and 📔 Memory reply, and the planner file chip pulses: today's plan changed.

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.meaning: Nani, what shall we play now?

helps.text: Out of every M word, Nani chose Mango, because Papa is bringing mangoes tonight. When Papa walks in, Aarav already knows the word. The lesson ends at the family table.
helps.hood: Lessons rewrites planner.md. The new plan takes over at Nani's next turn.

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.note: The lion appears on the wall and Nani asks for his roar.

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.meaning: I want Mumma to hear my roar!

steps.speaker: Aarav
steps.note: A call bubble in the chat, Mumma joins, hears the roar and replies.

helps.text: His excitement went to Mumma, not to a screen. Aarav learns that when he's excited, he shares it with his parents. That's EQ.
helps.hood: Nani's call marker fires only after a clear yes from the child.

chapters.title: What should I talk to him about?

steps.speaker: Papa
steps.line: Coming home soon. What should I talk to him about?
steps.note: 📔 Memory answers with today's real moments (Moon, the roar, the mango, the water) and three bedtime questions, plus a 📈 progress card.
Earlier weeks: sample history · Today: from this run.

helps.text: Memory knows the whole day, so Papa walks in with three questions instead of 'How was your day?'. And the report shows Aarav growing, week by week.
helps.hood: Memory reads today's turns and brain.md. Progress lives in Supabase (progress_days). The report is hand-made SVG.

finale.title: How it helped today

items.text: His own words became English (Chand → Moon)
Mumma guided from work in plain words
He shared his roar with Mumma
Papa knew what to talk about

finale.tagline: Nani teaches the words. The family gets closer.

lines.text: Child ↔ Nani: Scribe STT → Claude Haiku 5.5 (thinking off, low effort, Kimi k2.6 as the backup on each call) → Eleven v4 Turbo.
Parents' chat → sorter → Routine, House rules, Lessons and Memory → the agent files (persona, brain, planner, heartbeat, parent), versioned in Supabase → Nani's next turn.
Measured: median 2.45 s to first audio; stage script 15 of 15.
Nani's voice here is a library stand-in ("Dulari Didi", eleven_v4_turbo). In the product, the family's own grandma's voice is cloned.
In the product, Nani lives in a plush toy and the wall on a projector. Here both run in the browser, on the same toy contract.
